first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and these two memories are directly relevant to the current bottlenecks. I intend to test a shorter, clearer onboarding flow with activation messaging rather than use promotional pricing, which previously harmed 30-day retention. Verification will confirm the archived evidence before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding to address the current 4% decline in completion and likely support the 6% activation decline. The verified source shows completion increased 13%, time-to-value fell by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention improved 3%, making this more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing. Activation messaging is also validated, but the single slot should prioritize the directly deteriorating onboarding funnel.
